q23250.en: In the situation shown in the figure, vehicle B must give way to all the other vehicles.

explain.short: B has a give way sign and turns left: it lets T and G pass, and also P, who goes straight towards it.
explain.rule: B and P have a give way sign: they let T and G pass first. The tram T goes before the car G. Then P (straight on) goes before B (turning left).
explain.trap: 'tutti gli altri' (all the others) is right here: B goes last.

sceneParams.caption: B gives way to everyone: B goes last

q23251.en: In the situation shown in the figure, vehicle T goes first.

explain.short: T is a tram on the road without a sign: B and P must wait, and the tram goes before the car G.
explain.rule: B and P have a give way sign: they let T and G pass first. The tram T goes before the car G. Then P (straight on) goes before B (turning left).
explain.trap: 'passa per primo' (goes first): yes, the tram T is first.

sceneParams.caption: Tram T goes first

q23252.en: In the situation shown in the figure, vehicle B goes through last.

explain.short: B has a give way sign and turns left, so it waits for T, G and P: it is the last one.
explain.rule: B and P have a give way sign: they let T and G pass first. The tram T goes before the car G. Then P (straight on) goes before B (turning left).
explain.trap: 'per ultimo' (last): yes, B is last.

sceneParams.caption: Order T, G, P, B: B is last

q23253.en: In the situation shown in the figure, vehicle P must give way to vehicles T and G.

explain.short: P has a give way sign, so it lets T and G, on the other road, pass first.
explain.rule: B and P have a give way sign: they let T and G pass first. The tram T goes before the car G. Then P (straight on) goes before B (turning left).
explain.trap: 'ai veicoli T e G': exactly the two vehicles on the road without a sign.

sceneParams.caption: P has give way: T and G pass first

q23254.en: In the situation shown in the figure, the vehicles go through in this order: T, G, P, B.

explain.short: The tram first, then G on the same road, then P (straight on), and B (turning left) last.
explain.rule: B and P have a give way sign: they let T and G pass first. The tram T goes before the car G. Then P (straight on) goes before B (turning left).
explain.trap: Check every place in the 'ordine' (order): here all four are right.

sceneParams.caption: Correct order: T, G, P, B

q23255.en: In the situation shown in the figure, vehicle G must wait for vehicle T to go through.

explain.short: Trams generally have priority over vehicles without rails, so G lets the tram T go first.
explain.rule: B and P have a give way sign: they let T and G pass first. The tram T goes before the car G. Then P (straight on) goes before B (turning left).
explain.trap: 'deve attendere' (must wait): yes, G waits for the tram.

sceneParams.caption: G waits for the tram T

q23256.en: In the situation shown in the figure, vehicle T must wait for vehicle G to go through.

explain.short: It is the other way round: the tram T has priority, and G waits for it.
explain.rule: B and P have a give way sign: they let T and G pass first. The tram T goes before the car G. Then P (straight on) goes before B (turning left).
explain.trap: The names are swapped: it is G that must 'attendere' (wait) for T.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong way round: G waits for the tram T

q23257.en: In the situation shown in the figure, vehicle G goes through first.

explain.short: G is second: the tram T has priority and goes before it.
explain.rule: B and P have a give way sign: they let T and G pass first. The tram T goes before the car G. Then P (straight on) goes before B (turning left).
explain.trap: 'per primo' (first) is wrong: first is the tram T.

sceneParams.caption: First is the tram T, then G

q23258.en: In the situation shown in the figure, vehicle B enters the junction first and must stop in the centre of it.

explain.short: B has a give way sign and turns left: it goes last, after T, G and P.
explain.rule: B and P have a give way sign: they let T and G pass first. The tram T goes before the car G. Then P (straight on) goes before B (turning left).
explain.trap: 'impegna per primo' (enters first) is wrong: B is the last one.

sceneParams.caption: B does not go first: B is last

q23259.en: In the situation shown in the figure, vehicle T enters the junction first, but must stop in the centre of it.

explain.short: The tram T goes first and crosses without stopping: it has to wait for nobody.
explain.rule: B and P have a give way sign: they let T and G pass first. The tram T goes before the car G. Then P (straight on) goes before B (turning left).
explain.trap: The first part is right, but 'deve fermarsi al centro' (must stop in the centre) is wrong.

sceneParams.caption: Tram T goes first and does NOT stop

q23260.en: In the situation shown in the figure, the vehicles go through in this order: T, P, G, B.

explain.short: P has a give way sign, so it must wait for G too: G goes before P.
explain.rule: B and P have a give way sign: they let T and G pass first. The tram T goes before the car G. Then P (straight on) goes before B (turning left).
explain.trap: In the 'ordine' (order), P and G are swapped.

sceneParams.caption: Correct order: T, G, P, B (G before P)

q23261.en: In the situation shown in the figure, vehicle P goes through immediately after vehicle T.

explain.short: After the tram T comes G, not P: P has a give way sign and waits for G too.
explain.rule: B and P have a give way sign: they let T and G pass first. The tram T goes before the car G. Then P (straight on) goes before B (turning left).
explain.trap: 'subito dopo' (immediately after) is wrong: G is between T and P.

sceneParams.caption: After T comes G, then P

q23262.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction shown in the figure, vehicle N must wait for vehicle E to go through.

explain.short: E comes from N's right, so N gives way to E.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to the vehicle on your right. L turns right and crosses nobody, so it goes first; then E, then N, then R. A trolleybus has no rails, so it has no special priority.
explain.trap: 'deve attendere' (must wait): yes, because E is on N's right.

sceneParams.caption: E is on N's right: N waits

q23263.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction shown in the figure, vehicle E must wait for vehicle L to go through.

explain.short: L comes from E's right, so E gives way to L.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to the vehicle on your right. L turns right and crosses nobody, so it goes first; then E, then N, then R. A trolleybus has no rails, so it has no special priority.
explain.trap: 'deve attendere' (must wait): yes, L is on E's right.

sceneParams.caption: L is on E's right: E waits

q23264.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction shown in the figure, vehicle R must wait for vehicles E and N to go through.

explain.short: N is on R's right, so R waits for N; and N must first wait for E. So R goes after both.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to the vehicle on your right. L turns right and crosses nobody, so it goes first; then E, then N, then R. A trolleybus has no rails, so it has no special priority.
explain.trap: 'dei veicoli E ed N' (vehicles E and N): both pass before R.

sceneParams.caption: R is last: after E and N

q23265.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction shown in the figure, the vehicles go through in this order: L, E, N, R.

explain.short: L turns right and crosses nobody, so it is first; then each vehicle waits for the one on its right: E, N, R.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to the vehicle on your right. L turns right and crosses nobody, so it goes first; then E, then N, then R. A trolleybus has no rails, so it has no special priority.
explain.trap: Check every place in the 'ordine' (order): here all four are right.

sceneParams.caption: Correct order: L, E, N, R

q23266.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction shown in the figure, vehicle R (trolleybus) has priority over the other vehicles.

explain.short: A trolleybus (filobus) has no rails, so it has no special priority: R has N on its right and goes last.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to the vehicle on your right. L turns right and crosses nobody, so it goes first; then E, then N, then R. A trolleybus has no rails, so it has no special priority.
explain.trap: 'filobus' is not a tram: only vehicles on rails get the tram's priority.

sceneParams.caption: Trolleybus R has no priority: it goes last

q23267.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction shown in the figure, vehicle E must wait for vehicle R to go through.

explain.short: R is not on E's right: it comes from the opposite side and turns left. E waits only for L.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to the vehicle on your right. L turns right and crosses nobody, so it goes first; then E, then N, then R. A trolleybus has no rails, so it has no special priority.
explain.trap: 'deve attendere ... R' is wrong: R goes after E.

sceneParams.caption: E waits only for L; R goes after E

q23268.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction shown in the figure, vehicle L must wait for vehicle R to go through.

explain.short: L turns right and its path does not cross R's path, so L goes first and does not wait for R.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to the vehicle on your right. L turns right and crosses nobody, so it goes first; then E, then N, then R. A trolleybus has no rails, so it has no special priority.
explain.trap: 'deve attendere' (must wait) is wrong: L is the first to go.

sceneParams.caption: L turns right and goes first

q23269.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction shown in the figure, vehicle E must wait for vehicles N and R to go through.

explain.short: N is on E's left and R comes from the opposite side: both wait for E. E waits only for L.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to the vehicle on your right. L turns right and crosses nobody, so it goes first; then E, then N, then R. A trolleybus has no rails, so it has no special priority.
explain.trap: 'dei veicoli N e R' is wrong: they pass after E.

sceneParams.caption: E waits only for L, not for N and R

q23270.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction shown in the figure, vehicle E must wait for vehicle N to go through.

explain.short: It is the other way round: E is on N's right, so N waits for E.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to the vehicle on your right. L turns right and crosses nobody, so it goes first; then E, then N, then R. A trolleybus has no rails, so it has no special priority.
explain.trap: The names are swapped: it is N that must 'attendere' (wait) for E.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong way round: N waits for E

q23271.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction shown in the figure, the vehicles go through in this order: R, L, E, N.

explain.short: R is not first: it is a trolleybus with no special priority, and it waits for N on its right. The order is L, E, N, R.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to the vehicle on your right. L turns right and crosses nobody, so it goes first; then E, then N, then R. A trolleybus has no rails, so it has no special priority.
explain.trap: In the 'ordine' (order), R is put first, but it is last.

sceneParams.caption: Correct order: L, E, N, R (R last)

q23272.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction in the figure, vehicle F must wait for vehicle A to go through.

explain.short: A comes from F's right, so the bus F gives way to A.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to the vehicle on your right. H turns right and crosses nobody, so it goes first; then A (H on its right), then F (A on its right), then L (F on its right).
explain.trap: 'deve attendere' (must wait): yes, A is on F's right.

sceneParams.caption: A is on F's right: F waits

q23273.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction in the figure, vehicle L must wait for vehicles A and F to go through.

explain.short: F is on L's right, so L waits for F; and F first waits for A. So L goes after both.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to the vehicle on your right. H turns right and crosses nobody, so it goes first; then A (H on its right), then F (A on its right), then L (F on its right).
explain.trap: 'dei veicoli A ed F' (vehicles A and F): both pass before L.

sceneParams.caption: L waits for A and F

q23274.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction in the figure, vehicle A must wait for vehicle H to go through.

explain.short: H comes from A's right, so A gives way to H.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to the vehicle on your right. H turns right and crosses nobody, so it goes first; then A (H on its right), then F (A on its right), then L (F on its right).
explain.trap: 'deve attendere' (must wait): yes, H is on A's right.

sceneParams.caption: H is on A's right: A waits

q23275.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction in the figure, vehicle L must go through last.

explain.short: L has F on its right, F has A, and A has H: L waits for all of them.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to the vehicle on your right. H turns right and crosses nobody, so it goes first; then A (H on its right), then F (A on its right), then L (F on its right).
explain.trap: 'per ultimo' (last): yes, L is last.

sceneParams.caption: Order H, A, F, L: L is last

q23276.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction in the figure, vehicle H goes through first.

explain.short: H turns right and crosses nobody's path, so it goes first.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to the vehicle on your right. H turns right and crosses nobody, so it goes first; then A (H on its right), then F (A on its right), then L (F on its right).
explain.trap: 'per primo' (first): yes, H is first.

sceneParams.caption: H turns right and goes first

q23277.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction in the figure, the vehicles must go through in this order: H, A, F, L.

explain.short: H turns right and is first; then each vehicle waits for the one on its right: A, F, L.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to the vehicle on your right. H turns right and crosses nobody, so it goes first; then A (H on its right), then F (A on its right), then L (F on its right).
explain.trap: Check every place in the 'ordine' (order): here all four are right.

sceneParams.caption: Correct order: H, A, F, L

q23278.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction in the figure, the vehicles must go through in this order: A, F, L, H.

explain.short: H is not last: it turns right, crosses nobody and goes first. A waits for H.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to the vehicle on your right. H turns right and crosses nobody, so it goes first; then A (H on its right), then F (A on its right), then L (F on its right).
explain.trap: In the 'ordine' (order), H is put last, but it is first.

sceneParams.caption: Correct order: H, A, F, L (H first)

q23279.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction in the figure, vehicle F must go through first.

explain.short: The bus F has A on its right, so it waits for A (and A waits for H). F is third.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to the vehicle on your right. H turns right and crosses nobody, so it goes first; then A (H on its right), then F (A on its right), then L (F on its right).
explain.trap: 'per primo' (first) is wrong: a bus has no special priority.

sceneParams.caption: F is third: H, A, then F

q23280.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction in the figure, vehicle H must wait for vehicle L to go through.

explain.short: H turns right and does not cross L's path, so H goes first; L is the last.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to the vehicle on your right. H turns right and crosses nobody, so it goes first; then A (H on its right), then F (A on its right), then L (F on its right).
explain.trap: 'deve attendere' (must wait) is wrong: H waits for nobody.

sceneParams.caption: H goes first; L is last

q23281.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction in the figure, vehicle H must wait for vehicle F to go through.

explain.short: H turns right and crosses nobody, so H goes first; the bus F is third.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to the vehicle on your right. H turns right and crosses nobody, so it goes first; then A (H on its right), then F (A on its right), then L (F on its right).
explain.trap: 'deve attendere' (must wait) is wrong: H waits for nobody.

sceneParams.caption: H goes first; F is third

q23282.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction in the figure, vehicle A must wait for vehicle F to go through.

explain.short: It is the other way round: A is on F's right, so F waits for A.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to the vehicle on your right. H turns right and crosses nobody, so it goes first; then A (H on its right), then F (A on its right), then L (F on its right).
explain.trap: The names are swapped: it is F that must 'attendere' (wait) for A.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong way round: F waits for A

q23283.en: At the junction shown in the figure, the driver of vehicle N is the last to finish crossing the junction.

explain.short: N moves to the centre and stops; R and A pass, and only then N finishes its left turn.
explain.rule: R gives way to N (N is on R's right). N turns left, so it gives way to A, who comes straight from the other side. A gives way to R. So N moves to the centre and stops; R passes, then A, then N completes its turn.
explain.trap: 'conclude per ultimo' (finishes last): yes, N finishes last.

sceneParams.caption: N finishes its left turn last

q23284.en: At the junction shown in the figure, vehicle N must give way to vehicle A.

explain.short: N turns left, and A comes straight from the opposite side: a left turn gives way to oncoming traffic going straight.
explain.rule: R gives way to N (N is on R's right). N turns left, so it gives way to A, who comes straight from the other side. A gives way to R. So N moves to the centre and stops; R passes, then A, then N completes its turn.
explain.trap: 'dare la precedenza al veicolo A': yes, A is oncoming and goes straight.

sceneParams.caption: N turns left: it gives way to oncoming A

q23285.en: At the junction shown in the figure, vehicle N has priority over vehicle R.

explain.short: N is on R's right, so R must give way to N.
explain.rule: R gives way to N (N is on R's right). N turns left, so it gives way to A, who comes straight from the other side. A gives way to R. So N moves to the centre and stops; R passes, then A, then N completes its turn.
explain.trap: 'ha la precedenza' (has priority): yes, over R, because N is on R's right.

sceneParams.caption: N is on R's right: N has priority over R

q23286.en: At the junction shown in the figure, vehicle N can finish its left turn after vehicles R and A have gone through.

explain.short: N waits in the centre; R passes, then A, and then N finishes its left turn.
explain.rule: R gives way to N (N is on R's right). N turns left, so it gives way to A, who comes straight from the other side. A gives way to R. So N moves to the centre and stops; R passes, then A, then N completes its turn.
explain.trap: 'dopo il transito dei veicoli R e A' (after R and A): yes, both pass first.

sceneParams.caption: N finishes after R and A

q23287.en: At the junction shown in the figure, vehicle N, after moving to the centre of the junction, must wait for vehicles R and A to go through.

explain.short: N has priority over R, so it can enter; but it must then wait in the centre for R and A.
explain.rule: R gives way to N (N is on R's right). N turns left, so it gives way to A, who comes straight from the other side. A gives way to R. So N moves to the centre and stops; R passes, then A, then N completes its turn.
explain.trap: 'dopo essersi portato al centro' (after moving to the centre): this is how the circle is broken.

sceneParams.caption: N moves to the centre, waits for R and A

keywords.en: in the centre of the junction

q23288.en: At the junction shown in the figure, vehicle N crosses first.

explain.short: N enters first but stops in the centre: it finishes crossing last, after R and A.
explain.rule: R gives way to N (N is on R's right). N turns left, so it gives way to A, who comes straight from the other side. A gives way to R. So N moves to the centre and stops; R passes, then A, then N completes its turn.
explain.trap: 'attraversa per primo' (crosses first) is wrong: N enters first but crosses last.

sceneParams.caption: N enters first but crosses last

q23289.en: At the junction shown in the figure, vehicle N must give way to vehicle R.

explain.short: It is the other way round: N is on R's right, so R gives way to N.
explain.rule: R gives way to N (N is on R's right). N turns left, so it gives way to A, who comes straight from the other side. A gives way to R. So N moves to the centre and stops; R passes, then A, then N completes its turn.
explain.trap: The names are swapped: R must 'dare la precedenza' (give way) to N.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong way round: R gives way to N

q23290.en: At the junction shown in the figure, vehicle N has priority over vehicle A.

explain.short: N turns left and A comes straight from the opposite side: N must give way to A.
explain.rule: R gives way to N (N is on R's right). N turns left, so it gives way to A, who comes straight from the other side. A gives way to R. So N moves to the centre and stops; R passes, then A, then N completes its turn.
explain.trap: 'ha la precedenza' (has priority) is wrong: a left turn gives way to oncoming straight traffic.

sceneParams.caption: N turns left: it gives way to A

q23291.en: At the junction shown in the figure, vehicle N goes after vehicle R has gone through, but before vehicle A goes through.

explain.short: The first part is right, but N must also wait for A: it finishes after both R and A.
explain.rule: R gives way to N (N is on R's right). N turns left, so it gives way to A, who comes straight from the other side. A gives way to R. So N moves to the centre and stops; R passes, then A, then N completes its turn.
explain.trap: 'ma prima che transiti il veicolo A' (but before A) is wrong.

sceneParams.caption: N finishes after R AND after A

q23292.en: At the junction shown in the figure, vehicle N enters the junction last.

explain.short: N enters the junction FIRST (it has priority over R) and stops in the centre; it only finishes last.
explain.rule: R gives way to N (N is on R's right). N turns left, so it gives way to A, who comes straight from the other side. A gives way to R. So N moves to the centre and stops; R passes, then A, then N completes its turn.
explain.trap: 'impegna ... per ultimo' (enters last) is wrong: N enters first and finishes last.

sceneParams.caption: N enters first, then waits in the centre

q23293.en: At the junction shown in the figure, vehicle A must give way to the tram and to vehicle B.

explain.short: The tram has priority over vehicles without rails, and B comes from A's right.
explain.rule: No signs. The tram T has priority, and B has nobody on its right. T and B go opposite ways without crossing, so they go together. Then A (B was on its right), and last C (A is on its right).
explain.trap: 'al tram e al veicolo B' (to the tram and B): yes, both.

sceneParams.caption: A gives way to the tram T and to B

q23294.en: At the junction shown in the figure, vehicle A has priority over vehicle C.

explain.short: A is on C's right, so C must give way to A.
explain.rule: No signs. The tram T has priority, and B has nobody on its right. T and B go opposite ways without crossing, so they go together. Then A (B was on its right), and last C (A is on its right).
explain.trap: 'ha la precedenza' (has priority): yes, over C.

sceneParams.caption: A is on C's right: C waits for A

q23295.en: At the junction shown in the figure, the vehicles go through in this order: T and B, A, C.

explain.short: The tram and B go together, then A, and C last.
explain.rule: No signs. The tram T has priority, and B has nobody on its right. T and B go opposite ways without crossing, so they go together. Then A (B was on its right), and last C (A is on its right).
explain.trap: 'T e B' together at first place: right, their paths do not cross.

sceneParams.caption: Correct order: T and B, then A, then C

q23296.en: At the junction shown in the figure, vehicles T and B can go through at the same time.

explain.short: The tram has priority, B has nobody on its right, and they go opposite ways without crossing.
explain.rule: No signs. The tram T has priority, and B has nobody on its right. T and B go opposite ways without crossing, so they go together. Then A (B was on its right), and last C (A is on its right).
explain.trap: 'contemporaneamente' (at the same time) is right here: their paths do not cross.

sceneParams.caption: T and B go together: paths do not cross

q23297.en: At the junction shown in the figure, vehicle C goes through last.

explain.short: C has A on its right, and A waits for the tram and B: so C is the last one.
explain.rule: No signs. The tram T has priority, and B has nobody on its right. T and B go opposite ways without crossing, so they go together. Then A (B was on its right), and last C (A is on its right).
explain.trap: 'per ultimo' (last): yes, C is last.

sceneParams.caption: Order T+B, A, C: C is last

q23298.en: At the junction shown in the figure, vehicles T and C go through at the same time.

explain.short: C cannot go with the tram: C has A on its right and must wait for A, who goes after the tram.
explain.rule: No signs. The tram T has priority, and B has nobody on its right. T and B go opposite ways without crossing, so they go together. Then A (B was on its right), and last C (A is on its right).
explain.trap: 'contemporaneamente' (at the same time) is wrong: T goes with B, not with C.

sceneParams.caption: T goes with B; C is last

q23299.en: At the junction shown in the figure, the vehicles go through in this order: T, B, C, A.

explain.short: C cannot go before A: A is on C's right. Also T and B go together.
explain.rule: No signs. The tram T has priority, and B has nobody on its right. T and B go opposite ways without crossing, so they go together. Then A (B was on its right), and last C (A is on its right).
explain.trap: In the 'ordine' (order), A and C are swapped.

sceneParams.caption: Correct order: T and B, A, C (A before C)

q23300.en: At the junction shown in the figure, vehicle A goes through last.

explain.short: A is third: C is last, because A is on C's right.
explain.rule: No signs. The tram T has priority, and B has nobody on its right. T and B go opposite ways without crossing, so they go together. Then A (B was on its right), and last C (A is on its right).
explain.trap: 'per ultimo' (last) is wrong: the last one is C.

sceneParams.caption: A is third; C is last

q23301.en: At the junction shown in the figure, vehicles T, B, C go through at the same time.

explain.short: T and B go together, but C must wait for A (on its right), so C goes last.
explain.rule: No signs. The tram T has priority, and B has nobody on its right. T and B go opposite ways without crossing, so they go together. Then A (B was on its right), and last C (A is on its right).
explain.trap: 'T, B, C' together is wrong: only T and B go together.

sceneParams.caption: Only T and B go together; C is last

q23302.en: At the junction shown in the figure, vehicle B must give way to vehicle A.

explain.short: It is the other way round: B is on A's right, so A gives way to B.
explain.rule: No signs. The tram T has priority, and B has nobody on its right. T and B go opposite ways without crossing, so they go together. Then A (B was on its right), and last C (A is on its right).
explain.trap: The names are swapped: A must 'dare la precedenza' (give way) to B.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong way round: A gives way to B

q23303.en: At the junction shown in the figure, the driver of vehicle D goes first.

explain.short: Nobody comes from D's right, and the oncoming car A also turns left: D waits for no one.
explain.rule: No signs. D has nobody on its right. The only vehicle coming towards D is A, and A also turns left, so D gives way to no one. A left-turner gives way only to ONCOMING traffic going straight or right.
explain.trap: 'passa per primo' (goes first): yes, D is first.

sceneParams.caption: D gives way to nobody: D goes first

q23304.en: At the junction shown in the figure, the driver of vehicle D does not have to give way to any vehicle.

explain.short: No one is on D's right, E and S are on its left, and A coming towards it also turns left.
explain.rule: No signs. D has nobody on its right. The only vehicle coming towards D is A, and A also turns left, so D gives way to no one. A left-turner gives way only to ONCOMING traffic going straight or right.
explain.trap: 'non ... ad alcun veicolo' (to no vehicle): right, D gives way to no one.

sceneParams.caption: D gives way to no one

q23305.en: At the junction shown in the figure, the driver of vehicle D does not have to give way to vehicle A.

explain.short: A comes towards D but it is also turning left, and A is on D's left: D does not wait for A.
explain.rule: No signs. D has nobody on its right. The only vehicle coming towards D is A, and A also turns left, so D gives way to no one. A left-turner gives way only to ONCOMING traffic going straight or right.
explain.trap: 'non ha l'obbligo' (does not have to): right, A must wait for E and S anyway.

sceneParams.caption: D does not wait for A

q23306.en: At the junction shown in the figure, the driver of vehicle D goes third.

explain.short: D goes first: nobody comes from its right and A, oncoming, also turns left.
explain.rule: No signs. D has nobody on its right. The only vehicle coming towards D is A, and A also turns left, so D gives way to no one. A left-turner gives way only to ONCOMING traffic going straight or right.
explain.trap: 'per terzo' (third) is wrong: D is first.

sceneParams.caption: D goes first, not third

q23307.en: At the junction shown in the figure, the driver of vehicle D must give way to all the vehicles.

explain.short: D gives way to no one: nobody is on its right, and A coming towards it also turns left.
explain.rule: No signs. D has nobody on its right. The only vehicle coming towards D is A, and A also turns left, so D gives way to no one. A left-turner gives way only to ONCOMING traffic going straight or right.
explain.trap: 'a tutti i veicoli' (to all vehicles) is wrong: D goes first.

sceneParams.caption: D gives way to nobody

q23308.en: At the junction shown in the figure, the driver of vehicle D must give way to vehicle E, which goes straight on.

explain.short: E comes from D's LEFT, so E waits for D. A left-turner gives way only to ONCOMING traffic going straight.
explain.rule: No signs. D has nobody on its right. The only vehicle coming towards D is A, and A also turns left, so D gives way to no one. A left-turner gives way only to ONCOMING traffic going straight or right.
explain.trap: 'che prosegue diritto' (which goes straight) is a trap: E is not oncoming, it is on D's left.

sceneParams.caption: E comes from D's left: E waits for D

q23309.en: At the junction shown in the figure, the driver of vehicle R must give way to vehicle N.

explain.short: N is on R's right, so R must give way to N; N then stops in the centre to let R pass.
explain.rule: R gives way to N (N is on R's right). N turns left, so it gives way to A, who comes straight from the other side. A gives way to R. So N moves to the centre and stops; R passes, then A, then N completes its turn.
explain.trap: 'deve dare la precedenza' (must give way): yes, N is on R's right.

sceneParams.caption: N is on R's right: R lets N enter first

q23310.en: At the junction shown in the figure, the driver of vehicle R has priority over vehicle A.

explain.short: R is on A's right, so A must give way to R.
explain.rule: R gives way to N (N is on R's right). N turns left, so it gives way to A, who comes straight from the other side. A gives way to R. So N moves to the centre and stops; R passes, then A, then N completes its turn.
explain.trap: 'ha la precedenza' (has priority): yes, R is on A's right.

sceneParams.caption: R is on A's right: A waits for R

q23311.en: At the junction shown in the figure, the driver of vehicle R crosses the junction after vehicle N has stopped in the centre of the junction.

explain.short: N enters first and stops in the centre (it must wait for A); then R can cross.
explain.rule: R gives way to N (N is on R's right). N turns left, so it gives way to A, who comes straight from the other side. A gives way to R. So N moves to the centre and stops; R passes, then A, then N completes its turn.
explain.trap: 'dopo che ... si è fermato al centro' (after N has stopped in the centre): yes.

sceneParams.caption: N stops in the centre, then R crosses

q23312.en: At the junction shown in the figure, the driver of vehicle R goes before vehicle A.

explain.short: R is on A's right, so A waits and R passes first.
explain.rule: R gives way to N (N is on R's right). N turns left, so it gives way to A, who comes straight from the other side. A gives way to R. So N moves to the centre and stops; R passes, then A, then N completes its turn.
explain.trap: 'prima del veicolo A' (before A): yes.

sceneParams.caption: R goes before A

q23313.en: At the junction shown in the figure, the driver of vehicle R is the first to finish crossing.

explain.short: N waits in the centre, A waits for R: R is the first to complete the crossing.
explain.rule: R gives way to N (N is on R's right). N turns left, so it gives way to A, who comes straight from the other side. A gives way to R. So N moves to the centre and stops; R passes, then A, then N completes its turn.
explain.trap: 'conclude per primo' (finishes first): yes; N enters first, but R finishes first.

sceneParams.caption: R finishes crossing first

q23314.en: At the junction shown in the figure, the driver of vehicle R must give way to vehicle A.

explain.short: It is the other way round: R is on A's right, so A gives way to R.
explain.rule: R gives way to N (N is on R's right). N turns left, so it gives way to A, who comes straight from the other side. A gives way to R. So N moves to the centre and stops; R passes, then A, then N completes its turn.
explain.trap: The names are swapped: A must 'dare la precedenza' (give way) to R.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong way round: A gives way to R

q23315.en: At the junction shown in the figure, the driver of vehicle R goes last.

explain.short: R is the first to finish crossing; the last is N, who waits in the centre.
explain.rule: R gives way to N (N is on R's right). N turns left, so it gives way to A, who comes straight from the other side. A gives way to R. So N moves to the centre and stops; R passes, then A, then N completes its turn.
explain.trap: 'per ultimo' (last) is wrong: last is N.

sceneParams.caption: R is first; N finishes last

q23316.en: At the junction shown in the figure, the driver of vehicle R goes after vehicle A has gone through.

explain.short: R is on A's right, so A waits for R: R passes before A.
explain.rule: R gives way to N (N is on R's right). N turns left, so it gives way to A, who comes straight from the other side. A gives way to R. So N moves to the centre and stops; R passes, then A, then N completes its turn.
explain.trap: 'dopo il transito del veicolo A' (after A) is wrong: R goes before A.

sceneParams.caption: R goes before A, not after

q23317.en: At the junction shown in the figure, the driver of vehicle R enters the junction and stops in the centre.

explain.short: It is N (turning left) that stops in the centre. R goes straight across without stopping.
explain.rule: R gives way to N (N is on R's right). N turns left, so it gives way to A, who comes straight from the other side. A gives way to R. So N moves to the centre and stops; R passes, then A, then N completes its turn.
explain.trap: 'si ferma al centro' (stops in the centre) is wrong for R: that is what N does.

sceneParams.caption: N stops in the centre; R goes straight through
